semiconductor_relevance: High — Heli Gas specializes in the production of electronic-grade gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Heli Gas (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of excimer laser gases and electronic-grade pure gases essential for semiconductor applications. Their products support industries such as integrated circuits and display panel manufacturing, providing high-quality gas solutions tailored for efficiency and energy savings.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and serves various regions including Taiwan, South Korea, and Japan.
